params.name: Staircase maths
params.expr:
dir = direction == 'ltr' ? 1 : -1
n1 = (midSteps>0 && midSteps<steps) ? midSteps : floor(steps/2)
mid = (midSteps>0 && midSteps<steps-1) ? midSteps : max(1, round(steps/3))
aF = ceil(max(2, steps-mid)/2)
s2 = tread/2*dir
w2 = width/2
td = tread*dir
tdn = -tread*dir
cntS = (config=='straight')*steps
cLS = (steps*tread + landingWidth/2)*dir
gLS = (config=='straight') && landingWidth>0 ? 1 : 0
nR = steps*riser
nt = steps*tread
mU = config=='u-shape' ? 1 : 0
mM = config=='u-shape-mid' ? 1 : 0
cntU1 = (config=='u-shape')*n1
cntU2 = (config=='u-shape')*(steps-n1)
cXU = (n1*tread + landingWidth/2)*dir
bWG = 2*width + midSpace
bwh = width + midSpace/2
cX2 = (n1*tread - tread/2)*dir
y2c = 1.5*width + midSpace
n1R = n1*riser
h2S = (n1+1)*riser
cntM1 = (config=='u-shape-mid')*aF
cntM2 = (config=='u-shape-mid')*mid
cntM3 = (config=='u-shape-mid')*(max(2,steps-mid)-aF)
cL1 = (aF*tread + width/2)*dir
yF2 = width + tread/2
cy2 = width + mid*tread + width/2
cX3 = (aF*tread - tread/2)*dir
aR = aF*riser
apR = (aF+1)*riser
amR = (aF+mid)*riser
amR1 = (aF+mid+1)*riser
